?Court No. - 16
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 5392 of 2023

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Applicant :- Rajeev Alias Shivsagar
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home, Govt. Of U.P. Civil Sectt. Lko.

Counsel for Applicant :- Ajeet Kumar Singh
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.
1.
Heard Sri Ajeet Kumar Singh, learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Manoj Kumar Sahu, learned AGA for the State and perused the record.

2. The present bail application has been filed by the applicant with the prayer to enlarge him on bail in Case Crime No. 548 of 2022, under Sections 363, 366, 376 IPC & 3/4 of POCSO Act, Police Station Kotwali Dehat, District Hardoi.

3. The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of an FIR lodged on 12.10.2022 against the applicant and three of his family members, alleging that the applicant had enticed away the applicant's minor daughter at about 09:30 am on 27.09.2022.
4.

In the statement of the victim recorded under Section 161 Cr.P.C., she stated her age to be 18 years and she stated that she went alone from her home to Pihani by bus, where she met the applicant and thereafter both of them went to Ludhiana and they married each other.
Rajeev Alias Shivsagar vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home, ... on 21 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/128569187/

entities.text: Rajeev Alias Shivsagar vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In the statement of the victim recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C. also, she reiterated the aforesaid version.

6. Having considered the aforesaid fact and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the fact that the applicant has consistently stated herself to be major and that she has gone with the applicant out of her own free will and she has married the applicant, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
7. Accordingly, this bail application is allowed.

8. Let the applicant Rajeev alias Shivsagar be released on bail in Case Crime No. 548 of 2022, under Sections 363, 366, 376 IPC & 3/4 of POCSO Act, Police Station Kotwali Dehat, District Hardoi on furnishing a bail bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of magistrate/court concerned.

Order Date :- 21.4.2023 Pradeep/-
